xp.note: XP measures engagement only. It never unlocks grades, never counts as mastery and never appears in readiness estimates. Each award has a unique source-event key; replays earn XP at most twice per node per day. Brief 04: the per-node daily cap counts awards, not requests; first completions and replays follow the same rule.

mastery.note: Thresholds are placeholders for Brief 04 to tune empirically and confirm with a teacher. Accessible alternative interactions carry the same evidence weight.

review.note: Per-concept spaced review. A wrong review answer triggers a worked explanation and a short remedial step before rescheduling. lapseResetsTo is read as an index into intervalsDays (0 = the first interval, so 1 = the second, 3 days); set it to 0 if the teacher prefers a lapse to restart at one day.

unlocking.lesson: A node unlocks when every node in its unlockAfter list is complete (default: the previous required lesson, practice or review node). Unlocked nodes can always be replayed.
unlocking.unit: The first lesson of a unit unlocks after the previous unit's review node. Unit challenges are mastery evidence and do not gate the next unit.
unlocking.grade: A grade world unlocks when the previous grade's teaching path is complete, or through placement (Brief 10). Learners may always start lower without penalty.
unlocking.gradeCompletion: An in-app grade badge requires passing the grade assessment, which independently samples every outcome introduced at that grade. XP and lesson completion never award it.

readiness.note: Configurable in-app readiness default. It is not presented as an official ABRSM pass mark.

daily.note: A meaningful session is a path node completed (every question answered correctly, decided by the server) or a review session finished. Opening the app, refreshing and abandoned or empty activity never count. Learners may keep the default of one session a day, choose up to five, or turn the goal off. A streak day is any calendar day in the learner's timezone with at least one meaningful session, whatever the goal; ending a streak never removes progress or mastery.

assessments.note: Provisional, awaiting teacher acceptance. A unit challenge or Grade assessment run is completed (and pays XP, unlocks the grade badge) only when it reaches the pass mark; a run below it is recorded as an honest result and can be retried with fresh questions. These marks are in-app practice thresholds, not ABRSM pass marks.
